summary: At approximately 19:51:55Z, the orders service experienced a spike in HTTP 500 errors following the deployment of orders version 1.4.0. The new code in DiscountService.apply fails with a NullPointerException when processing requests where the discount code is null, causing widespread order placement failures at both the orders service and edge gateway.

hypotheses.summary: The rollout of orders 1.4.0 introduced a NullPointerException in DiscountService.apply when handling orders without discount codes, causing order placement requests to fail with HTTP 500 errors.

evidence.shows: orders 1.4.0 was deployed right before errors started

evidence.quote: java.lang.NullPointerException: Cannot invoke "String.trim()" because "code" is null\nat dev.relay.sandbox.orders.pricing.DiscountService.apply(DiscountService.java:21)
evidence.shows: Unhandled NullPointerException in DiscountService.apply causes POST /orders to fail with 500 errors
HTTP 500 errors on orders surged immediately following the 1.4.0 deployment
HighErrorRate alert triggered on orders due to elevated request failure rates

hypotheses.suggested_fix: Roll back the orders deployment to version 1.3.0 and patch DiscountService.apply to handle null discount codes safely.
